svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print seven ring plates flat, bosses up: 110 mm across, 3 mm thick,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a 56 mm centre hole. Print six without the hub.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four bosses 10 mm across and 12 mm tall stand on each ring around

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5.5 mm rod holes on a 92 mm circle. Each boss carries the plate above,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the plates sit 15 mm apart with 12 mm air gaps.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The seventh ring (the third plate from the top) also has a hub 22 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across and 8 mm tall on three 4 mm spokes; its 18.5 mm bore holds

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the sensor capsule. Add a 2.5 mm side hole in the hub and tap or

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: thread-form it M3 for a nylon set screw.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the rods pass through the bosses; nothing is glued.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: eight plates stack 108 mm tall on the rods, gaps even.
